title: Are these safe for cats?
technique: The Dip's rhythm is written into each shot; one clip (@Video1) gives only the High flip.
story: Night, candles everywhere: a cat lady scrolls the Fig & Cedar page up and down, not buying.
Inner voice, lips closed, the camera circling her: “Are these safe for cats?”
She finds nothing, gets annoyed, closes the site: “I guess we'll never know.”
The High flip lands on the owner: “I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar.”
“No one wants this. Time to discontinue the product line.” She blows out the candle.
Scout: “Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.” “Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.”

shots.what: Opening shot. Wide slow arc past candles to her on the sofa.
The camera circles from her side to behind her shoulder.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: Over her shoulder: she scrolls down, up, down; nothing on pets.
Close on her face: brows pinch, sharp exhale, glance at the cat.
Medium: she closes the tab, the page disappears, she leans back.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: High flip: rises over her, over the sofa back, onto the owner.
Over her shoulder: red Fig & Cedar row; push in, she frowns.
shots.line: I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Medium: she decides, then blows out the jar's three flames.
shots.line: Time to discontinue the product line.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Close on the smoking jar, the owner soft behind it.
shots.line: Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: The smoke dissolves into Scout's end screen.
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout
